decisions.evidence: Read all four steps and exact block, projective-Hom, PBW/Verma and BGG suppliers. The sl2 identity on nonzero L(0) is killed since P(-2) has only head L(-2). The map M(0) to L(-2) is zero by weight support, while V of the socle inclusion identifies both one-dimensional module values, giving a nonzero C-module Hom target. L(-2) is infinite dimensional with weights -2,-4,..., as corrected by the reader. These witnesses are independently sound and do not require the generic Endomorphismensatz: once-each projective flag gives dim End P=2, and head-to-socle endomorphism n is nonzero with n^2=0 (a nonzero composite would split the simple head), so 1,n give C=complex[n]/n^2 directly in rank one. Both nonsplit surjections verify nonprojective targets. The stated general Struktursatz comparison is only a boundary explanation with the correct projective-target condition; no general acceptance is derived from it. Current counterexample is sound, with no all-object fullness assertion.
